derivation: or לָחֻם; passive participle of H3898 (לָחַם);
def: properly, eaten, i.e. food; also flesh, i.e. body

occurrences.text: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
